correctness.rationale: The Bittel et al. source supplies a pure-state exact learner in which codimension r falls by one with probability p_r=(1-2^{-r})/2 independently at successive geometric waiting times. Starting at r=n is the stochastic maximum over stabilizer states; if the learner halts before full diagonalization, the returned basis state cannot equal the remaining nonbasis stabilizer state. Thus F_n(T)=Pr(sum_{r=1}^n Geom(p_r)>T), without a missing success correction. Separating r=1, the bulk r>=2 log-mgf per n tends to Λ(theta)=log(e^theta/(2-e^theta)); its slope under tilt gives theta_x=log(2(x-1)/x), at x=3 attaining the r=1 MGF singularity a=log(4/3). Standard exponential Chernoff upper and tilted bulk lower bounds yield I0(x) for 2<x<=3. For x>=3, constrain the bulk to 3n+o(n) at rate 3a-log2 and assign excess (x-3)n+o(n) to G1 tail (3/4)^j: rate xa-log2. Endpoint continuity/differentiability follows directly. Our independent finite convolution checks at n=20,40,80 for x=2.5,3,4 were consistent with the limits but do not prove the triangular-array LDP.
